review: D87 signed-in native Settings source candidate

verdict_a_actual_runtime.evidence: The recorded D87 run proves authentication and the first theme save, then fails on the next menu open while the sidepanel document is hidden and body pointer-events is none. Candidate b23a5a8c has not been run natively.
verdict_a_actual_runtime.constraint: No native trial run; heavy/native permit remains with the parent.

verdict_b_source_quality.ownership_and_provenance: The callback closes over panelTarget.targetId only after the harness verifies the spawned profile, extension worker, distinct normal page, exact chrome-extension panel URL, and sidepanel execution context. It activates that target through CDP; it does not accept an arbitrary target id.
verdict_b_source_quality.activation_semantics: Signed-in flows call Target.activateTarget after signInSettings returns, then require document.visibilityState === visible before Settings pointer actions. This is a real browser target activation and visibility precondition, not a DOM/CSS/timer/pointer bypass. Guest behavior is unchanged.
verdict_b_source_quality.assertions: The original theme/menu trusted-input path and acceptance predicates remain intact. The new visibility observation only gates readiness; it does not convert failed pointer evidence into success.
verdict_b_source_quality.diagnostic_safety: pointerBoundary emits bounded visibility, booleans, and counts; it records no page text, credentials, token, organization name, or raw DOM. Existing auth report strips profile id/email/organization id before persistence.
verdict_b_source_quality.breakage_review: No source-level new breakage found. Target activation may focus the sidepanel window as intended; runtime behavior and the following repeated theme selections remain unverified.

review_basis: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs: target discovery, exact extension URL/context checks, and activation callback
tests/browser/settings-d87-native-acceptance.mjs: post-auth visibility gate, unchanged UI cases, bounded diagnostic
.research/settings-pointer-boundary-diagnosis.json: authenticated first-choice pass and hidden-panel pointer boundary
